title: He Lives
lyrics: I [G]serve a risen Savior, He's in the world today;
[G]I know that [B7]He is [Em]living, what-[A]ever men may [D7]say;
I see His hand of mercy, I hear His voice of cheer
And [A]just the time I need Him He's [A]always [D]near.
He [G]lives, He live[G7]s, Christ [C]Jesus lives to-[G]day!
He [D7]walks with me and [G]talks with me a-[A7]long life's narrow [D7]way.
He [G]lives, He live[G7]s, sal-[C]vation to im-[B]part!
You [E7]ask me how I [A7]know He lives? He [G]lives with-[D7]in my [G]heart.
I [G]serve a risen saviour; [C]He's [G]in the world today.
I [B]know that [Em]He is living [A7]whatever man may [D7]say.
I [G]see His hand of mercy, I hear His voice of cheer
And [A]just the time I [A7]need Him, [D]He's always there.
He [G]lives, He [G7]lives. [C]Christ [G]Jesus lives today!
He [D]walks with [G]me and He talks with me,
A[A]long life's [D7]narrow way.
He [G]lives, He [G7]lives, [C]salvation to [B]impart.
You [E7]ask me how I [A]know He lives; He [G]lives with[D]in my [G]heart
In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And tho' my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading thru all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.
Rejoice, rejoice, O Christian, lift up your voice and sing,
Eternal hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The hope of all who seek Him, the help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.
